---
title: "Test All Tables Clean"
output: 
  bookdown::pdf_document2:
    extra_dependencies: ["amsmath", "graphicx", "booktabs", "float"]
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
library(kableExtra)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)

format_table <- function(x, caption = NULL, font_size = 8.5, col_widths = NULL) {
  if (knitr::is_latex_output()) {
    k <- knitr::kable(x, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, caption = caption, row.names = FALSE)
    k <- kableExtra::kable_styling(k, font_size = font_size, latex_options = "HOLD_position")
    if (!is.null(col_widths)) {
      for (col_idx in names(col_widths)) {
        k <- kableExtra::column_spec(k, as.numeric(col_idx), width = col_widths[[col_idx]])
      }
    }
    return(k)
  } else {
    return(knitr::kable(x, caption = caption, row.names = FALSE))
  }
}
```

# Table 2: Baseline
```{r table-2}
tab_disp <- all_ce_results %>%
  mutate(
    Device_str = ifelse(Device == "TVICD", "TV-ICD", "S-ICD"),
    Mean_Cost = sprintf("£%s", format(round(Mean_Cost, 0), big.mark = ",")),
    Mean_QALY = sprintf("%.2f", Mean_QALY),
    Incremental_Cost = ifelse(Strategy == "Observed", "Ref", sprintf("£%s", format(round(Incremental_Cost, 0), big.mark = ","))),
    Incremental_QALY = ifelse(Strategy == "Observed", "Ref", sprintf("%.3f", Incremental_QALY)),
    ICER_str = case_when(
      Strategy == "Observed" ~ "Reference",
      ICER < 0 & as.numeric(Incremental_QALY) > 0 ~ sprintf("Dominates (£%s)", format(round(ICER, 0), big.mark = ",")),
      TRUE ~ sprintf("£%s", format(round(ICER, 0), big.mark = ","))
    ),
    INB_25k = ifelse(Strategy == "Observed", "Ref", sprintf("£%s", format(round(as.numeric(Incremental_QALY) * 25000 - as.numeric(all_ce_results$Incremental_Cost), 0), big.mark = ","))),
    INB_35k = ifelse(Strategy == "Observed", "Ref", sprintf("£%s", format(round(as.numeric(Incremental_QALY) * 35000 - as.numeric(all_ce_results$Incremental_Cost), 0), big.mark = ",")))
  ) %>%
  select(Device = Device_str, Strategy, Cost = Mean_Cost, `Inc Cost` = Incremental_Cost, QALY = Mean_QALY, `Inc QALY` = Incremental_QALY, ICER = ICER_str, `INB (£25k)` = INB_25k, `INB (£35k)` = INB_35k)

format_table(tab_disp, caption = "30-year baseline cost-effectiveness results per patient.", font_size = 8.5)
```

# Table 3: Frontier
```{r table-3}
inc_tab <- all_ce_results %>%
  group_by(Device) %>%
  arrange(Mean_Cost, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    Device_str = ifelse(Device == "TVICD", "TV-ICD", "S-ICD"),
    Inc_Cost = Mean_Cost - lag(Mean_Cost, default = 0),
    Inc_QALY = Mean_QALY - lag(Mean_QALY, default = first(Mean_QALY)),
    ICER_frontier = case_when(
      Strategy == "No ICD" ~ "—",
      Inc_Cost > 0 & Inc_QALY < 0 ~ "Dominated",
      TRUE ~ sprintf("£%s", format(round(Inc_Cost / Inc_QALY, 0), big.mark = ","))
    ),
    NMB_25k = sprintf("£%s", format(round(Mean_QALY * 25000 - Mean_Cost, 0), big.mark = ",")),
    NMB_35k = sprintf("£%s", format(round(Mean_QALY * 35000 - Mean_Cost, 0), big.mark = ",")),
    Mean_Cost_str = sprintf("£%s", format(round(Mean_Cost, 0), big.mark = ",")),
    Mean_QALY_str = sprintf("%.3f", Mean_QALY),
    Inc_Cost_str = ifelse(Strategy == "No ICD", "—", sprintf("+£%s", format(round(Inc_Cost, 0), big.mark = ","))),
    Inc_QALY_str = ifelse(Strategy == "No ICD", "—", sprintf("+%.3f", Inc_QALY))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Device = Device_str, Strategy, Cost = Mean_Cost_str, QALY = Mean_QALY_str,
         `Inc Cost` = Inc_Cost_str, `Inc QALY` = Inc_QALY_str,
         ICER = ICER_frontier, `NMB (£25k)` = NMB_25k, `NMB (£35k)` = NMB_35k)

format_table(inc_tab, caption = "Incremental frontier ranked by mean lifetime cost.", font_size = 8.5)
```

# Table 6: All Strat
```{r table-6}
strat_names <- c("Risk > 6%", "Risk > 4%", "Any Risk Factor", "Over 1 Risk Factor", "Over 2 Risk Factors", "Over 3 Risk Factors", "Observed", "No ICD")
tab_strat <- ce_data %>%
  mutate(
    Strat_Clean = strat_names[1:n()],
    TVICD_Cost = sprintf("£%s", format(round(TVICD_Cost, 0), big.mark = ",")),
    SICD_Cost  = sprintf("£%s", format(round(SICD_Cost, 0), big.mark = ",")),
    Delta_C    = sprintf("+£%s", format(round(Delta_C_Mean, 0), big.mark = ",")),
    Delta_E    = sprintf("+%.4f", Delta_E_Mean),
    INMB_25k   = sprintf("£%s (%s, %s)",
                         format(round(INMB_Mean, 0), big.mark = ","),
                         format(round(INMB_Lower, 0), big.mark = ","),
                         format(round(INMB_Upper, 0), big.mark = ",")),
    INMB_35k   = sprintf("£%s (%s, %s)",
                         format(round(INMB_Mean + Delta_E_Mean * 10000, 0), big.mark = ","),
                         format(round(INMB_Lower + Delta_E_Mean * 10000, 0), big.mark = ","),
                         format(round(INMB_Upper + Delta_E_Mean * 10000, 0), big.mark = ","))
  ) %>%
  select(Strategy = Strat_Clean, `TV-ICD Cost` = TVICD_Cost, `S-ICD Cost` = SICD_Cost,
         `Delta Cost` = Delta_C, `Delta QALY` = Delta_E,
         `INMB (£25k) (95% CrI)` = INMB_25k, `INMB (£35k) (95% CrI)` = INMB_35k)

format_table(tab_strat, caption = "Head-to-head comparison of S-ICD vs TV-ICD across all 8 strata.", font_size = 8)
```

# Table 7: Threshold
```{r table-7}
threshold_df <- data.frame(
  Decision_Context = c(
    "Head-to-Head Parity (Risk > 6%)",
    "Head-to-Head Parity (Risk > 4%)",
    "Head-to-Head Parity (Observed)",
    "Practice Transition (S-ICD > 6% vs. TV-ICD Obs)"
  ),
  Break_Even_25k = c("£12,761 (-26.8%)", "£12,753 (-26.8%)", "£12,620 (-27.6%)", "£22,230 (+27.5%)"),
  Break_Even_35k = c("£12,773 (-26.7%)", "£12,765 (-26.8%)", "£12,631 (-27.5%)", "£25,469 (+46.1%)"),
  Current_ICER = c("Dominated", "Dominated", "Dominated", "£10,198 / QALY"),
  Economic_Mechanism = c(
    "Must be discounted ~£2,550 below TV-ICD list price to compensate for 8-yr vs 10-yr battery replacement penalty.",
    "Must offset higher 30-year replacement frequency across 1,103 implanted patients.",
    "Must offset replacement burden under unguided historic selection.",
    "Risk > 6% clinical efficiency (avoiding low-risk implants) cross-subsidizes S-ICD hardware premium."
  )
)
colnames(threshold_df) <- c("Decision Context", "Break-Even (£25k)", "Break-Even (£35k)", "Current ICER", "Economic Rationale")

format_table(
  threshold_df,
  caption = "Price threshold analysis for S-ICD hardware and replacement costs (Current S-ICD price: £17,434).",
  font_size = 8.5,
  col_widths = list("5" = "5.2cm")
)
```
